description: FigJam only: connector (arrow) between two nodes. Endpoints attach via magnets (AUTO recommended), fixed positions, or float free. Default end cap ARROW_EQUILATERAL. STRAIGHT only supports CENTER/NONE magnets.

end.description: End: { nodeId, magnet } | { nodeId, position } | { position }

magnet.description: AUTO recommended; STRAIGHT lines allow only CENTER or NONE

nodeId.description: Node to attach to (omit to float free)

position.description: Relative to the node when nodeId is set, else absolute canvas coordinates

start.description: Start: { nodeId, magnet } | { nodeId, position } | { position }

magnet.description: AUTO recommended; STRAIGHT lines allow only CENTER or NONE

nodeId.description: Node to attach to (omit to float free)

position.description: Relative to the node when nodeId is set, else absolute canvas coordinates

name: figma_create_connector
